title.narrative: Emergency response to food and nutrition security crisis in Kabul, Balkh, Samangan and Jawzjan Provinces

description.narrative: Distribution of cash for food: cash adequate for three months supply of food will be distributed to 18.000 households in four Provinces of Balkh, Samangan, Jawzjan, and Kabul over winter 2023-24.2 Distribution of supplementary high nutrition food packages: households with a malnourished child enrolled in the clinical treatment of severe acute malnutrition will receive high-nutrition food packages (in kind and/ or vouchers). Target households will receive this in addition to cash for food hygiene and nutrition sensitization and a hygiene kit . Supplementary high-nutrition food packages will be distributed to a subset of 1.650 households in Balkh, Samangan, Jawzjan, and Kabul provinces over winter 2023-24.

Objective: The food and nutrition security of women, men, girls, and boys will improve, and the affected vulnerable communities will be better equipped to cope with shocks in Balkh, Samangan, Jawzjan, and Kabul Provinces of Afghanistan.Outcome: Vulnerable households classified in IPC3 are above able to meet their basic food and nutrition needs, improved their hygiene standards and resuscitated drinking water supply and WASH facilities in targeted villages.

WHH and a local partner will respond to the food security and nutrition of hard-to-reach communities which are categorized as IPC Level 3 (Crisis) and IPC Level 4 (Emergency) in the target provinces. The project will support a total of 19.220 households /134.540 individual women, men, girls, and boys (calculated on average household size of seven people), being residents or IDPs in the targeted communities. This figure is comprised of 18.000 households /126.000 individuals benefitting from the cash for food and associated subset activities, 720 households / 5.040 individuals from cash for work and 3.000 households / 21.000 individuals benefitting from the water trucking, with an overlap of approximately 2,500 households benefitting from both water provision and cash transfer activities.
